subject: gk
question: Which of the following options is NOT correct about plant cells?

options.text: Cell wall of a plant cell is made up of cellulose.
The plant cells cannot divide by mitosis.
A plant cell usually contains a large vacuole.
Generally, all plant cells contain chloroplast.

solution:
The correct answer is __**The plant cells cannot divide by mitosis**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** Plant cell:

__
 
• The outer cover of plant cell is called ‘cell wall’.
 
• Cell wall of a plant cell is made up of **cellulose.**
 
• It is a structural layer outside the cell membrane in the plant cells.
 
• It mainly provides structural support and protection to the plant cell and can be tough, flexible and sometimes rigid.
 
• Tonoplast is the layer of vacuole and endoplasmic reticulum is a cell organelle.
 
• Generally, all plant cells contain** chloroplast**.
 
• The plant cells can divide by **mitosis.**

Thus, the outer cover of the plant cell is called cell wall.__
